src-tauri/src/bin/test_owl.rs: Developer scratch binary used to check the ONNX and phoneme pipeline by hand; not part of the app.
src-tauri/src/commands/characters.rs: Character commands: create, read, list, update, trash, restore and permanently delete characters, and upload a portrait.
src-tauri/src/commands/conversations.rs: Conversation commands: create, list, search, rename, trash, restore, delete, branch, and set the active message, persona, image preset and memory scope.
src-tauri/src/commands/lorebook.rs: Lorebook commands: list, create, edit, toggle and delete entries, import a card's embedded lorebook, and generate entries from the story.
src-tauri/src/commands/messages.rs: Message commands: create, edit and delete messages, and read a branch or the sibling timelines of a message.
src-tauri/src/commands/providers.rs: Provider commands: create, edit, delete and test providers, list and enable models (chat, image/video, embedding), and the WanGP model list.
src-tauri/src/context/budget.rs: The token budget: how a context window is divided between fixed layers, summary, retrieved passages and recent messages.
src-tauri/src/context/summary.rs: Rolling summary of messages that no longer fit the context window.
src-tauri/src/context/tokenizer.rs: Token counting for text and messages (tiktoken-based approximation).
src-tauri/src/context/window.rs: The sliding window: keeps the newest messages that fit a token budget and reports how many were evicted.
src-tauri/src/db/ai_horde_models.rs: Repository for the cached AI Horde model catalogue (`ai_horde_model_info`).
src-tauri/src/db/character_state.rs: Repository for per-character, per-conversation emotional state.
src-tauri/src/db/characters.rs: Repository for characters, including NPC flags, portraits, voices and soft delete.
src-tauri/src/db/conversation_characters: Repository for the cast of a conversation: members, roles, talkativeness and the active flag.
src-tauri/src/db/conversations.rs: Repository for conversations: create, list, count, branch, soft delete and message-chain helpers.
src-tauri/src/db/embeddings.rs: Repository for message and memory embeddings, the vector index, and the hybrid (vector plus keyword) search queries.
src-tauri/src/db/image_presets.rs: Repository for image-generation presets and the per-account default.
src-tauri/src/db/lorebook.rs: Repository for lorebook entries, including import from a card's character book.
src-tauri/src/db/memories.rs: Repository for memories: lists, canon, importance, access tracking, links between conversations, and the memory graph.
src-tauri/src/db/messages.rs: Repository for messages: create, edit, reasoning text, metadata merge, branch and sibling queries.
src-tauri/src/db/mod.rs: Opens the embedded database, defines the schema, runs migrations and seeds defaults.
src-tauri/src/db/npc_candidates.rs: Repository for NPC candidates and the two-pass debounce that decides when one becomes a character.
src-tauri/src/db/personas.rs: Repository for personas, with avatars and soft delete.
src-tauri/src/db/providers.rs: Repository for provider configurations and the enabled-model records.
src-tauri/src/db/scene_states.rs: Repository for the scene state of a conversation.
src-tauri/src/db/scenes.rs: Repository for generated scenes (image and video records).
src-tauri/src/db/schema.rs: The database schema: every table, field, index and cascade event, as idempotent definitions run at each start.
src-tauri/src/db/seed.rs: Seeds the default image preset, and demo characters in debug builds only.
src-tauri/src/error.rs: `MythicError`, the single error type, plus validation, safe-path and retry helpers.
src-tauri/src/lib.rs: Library root: `AppState`, the command registry (specta bindings and Tauri handler), logging and application startup.
src-tauri/src/models/ai_horde_model.rs: Types for AI Horde model catalogue entries.
src-tauri/src/models/character.rs: Character and Character Card V2 types.
src-tauri/src/models/conversation.rs: Conversation, message, chat-message, attachment and generation-parameter types.
src-tauri/src/models/lorebook.rs: Lorebook entry types and the embedded character-book format.
src-tauri/src/models/memory.rs: Memory, memory link and memory graph types.
src-tauri/src/models/mod.rs: Shared serialization helpers (record ids, datetimes, flexible JSON) and the model modules.
src-tauri/src/models/npc_candidate.rs: NPC candidate type used by the detection debounce.
src-tauri/src/models/provider.rs: Provider configuration, model entry and capability types.
src-tauri/src/models/scene_state.rs: Scene state type (location, time, weather, characters present, mood).
src-tauri/src/models/user.rs: Account, session, signup-mode and network-setting types.
src-tauri/src/providers/traits.rs: `StreamChunk`, the unit of a streamed model reply (text, reasoning, done, error).

src/lib/components/ChatHeader.svelte: The chat header: character, branch link, and the toggles for lorebook, cast, persona, scene gallery and the context panel.
src/lib/components/ChatInput.svelte: The message box: text, attachments and paste, model picker, token count, send and stop.
src/lib/components/ChatMessage.svelte: One message: formatting, thinking block, voice playback, timelines, edit, regenerate, branch, copy, delete and error state.
src/lib/components/ContextCarousel.svelt: Character switcher shown at the top of the context panel.
src/lib/components/ContextLorebook.svelt: Lorebook editor for the current character: list, add, edit, reorder, import and generate entries.
src/lib/components/ContextMemories.svelt: The pinned-memory panel of a chat, with the memory-extraction toggle.
src/lib/components/ContextNpcPanel.svelt: The cast view: members, NPC review actions, portraits, and the cast memory graph.
src/lib/components/ContextPanel.svelte: The resizable side panel next to the chat showing character context.
src/lib/components/ContextPersonaPanel.s: Persona chooser for the current chat.
src/lib/components/EmotionHUD.svelte: Shows a character's mood, trust, intensity and dominant emotion.
src/lib/components/ErrorBoundary.svelte: Catches errors in a page and shows a recovery message instead of a blank screen.
src/lib/components/FirstRunWizard.svelte: The first-run setup guide: connect a model, test it, pick a model and start a chat with a starter character.
src/lib/components/Icon.svelte: The shared icon set, drawn as inline SVG by name.
src/lib/components/MemoryActionPanel.sve: Panel for acting on a memory or group: edit, promote to canon, set importance, share and unlink.
src/lib/components/MemoryGraph.svelte: The memory graph view, built on a node-and-edge canvas.
src/lib/components/MemoryTimeline.svelte: The memory timeline view, one lane per conversation.
src/lib/components/PersonaPicker.svelte: Compact persona dropdown used in the chat.
src/lib/components/SceneDisplay.svelte: The Scene panel: generate, edit and save scene images and videos with their options.
src/lib/components/SceneGalleryModal.sve: Gallery of a chat's generated scenes with full generation details.
src/lib/components/SceneStateBar.svelte: The bar showing the scene's location, who is present, ambience and mood.
src/lib/components/SettingsAppearanceSec: Settings section: theme and font size.
src/lib/components/SettingsChatSection.s: Settings section: streaming, thinking, automatic scene images and memory saving.
src/lib/components/SettingsContextSectio: Settings section: context window, summaries, semantic memory and the embedding index.
Settings section: mature-content flag, NPC portrait options and image presets.
src/lib/components/SettingsLoggingSectio: Settings section: backend and frontend logs with search and export.
src/lib/components/SettingsNetworkSectio: Settings section: browser access, signup mode, accounts and switching the desktop's account (desktop only, admin only).
src/lib/components/SettingsPrivacySectio: Settings section: privacy mode, export and import of data, and clearing conversations.
src/lib/components/SettingsPromptsSectio: Settings section: the system prompt, narrative direction and profile refresh prompt.
Settings section: voice output, provider, model download and default voice.
src/lib/components/Sidebar.svelte: The sidebar: navigation, conversation list, search, trash and settings; a drawer on phones.
src/lib/components/SidebarContextMenu.sv: The rename and delete menu for a conversation.
src/lib/components/SidebarConversationLi: Conversations grouped by character, with rename and selection.
src/lib/components/SidebarNav.svelte: The navigation links, including the AI Studio group.
src/lib/components/SidebarSearch.svelte: Full-text message search in the sidebar with keyboard navigation.
src/lib/components/SplitHeading.svelte: A heading whose words alternate between the two brand colours.
src/lib/components/ThinkingBlock.svelte: The collapsible block showing a reasoning model's thinking.
src/lib/components/TimelineFilter.svelte: Filter for choosing which memory timelines to show.
src/lib/components/TitleBar.svelte: The custom title bar: sidebar toggle, voice stop, brand, and window buttons (or account and Sign out in a browser).
src/lib/components/WebGate.svelte: The browser sign-in screen: landing, sign in, recovery, create account, recovery key and welcome.
src/lib/components/edges/SharingEdge.sve: Graph edge for a memory-sharing link between conversations.

src/lib/components/nodes/ConversationNod: Graph node for a conversation timeline.
src/lib/components/nodes/MemoryGroupNode: Graph node for a group of memories.
src/lib/components/nodes/MemoryNode.svel: Graph node for a single memory.
src/lib/services/webBridge.test.ts: Tests for the browser transport: commands, errors, events, files and pickers.
src/lib/utils/onboarding.test.ts: Tests for the first-run helpers and starter characters.
